name: roop-eval-v1
description: Machine-checkable coding tasks for local model success-rate tables

tasks.title: Implement mean and median
tasks.description: Implement only the source file under src/. Do NOT create or modify tests; golden tests are already provided. Create src/math_utils.py with mean() and median(). Empty list raises ValueError. Do not mutate input.
tasks.acceptance_criteria: mean/median behave as described; unittest passes

tasks.title: Implement clamp utility
tasks.description: Implement only the source file under src/. Do NOT create or modify tests; golden tests are already provided. Create src/clamp.py with clamp(value, low, high) returning value limited to [low, high]. If low > high raise ValueError.

tasks.title: Implement slugify
tasks.description: Implement only the source file under src/. Do NOT create or modify tests; golden tests are already provided. Create src/slugify.py with slugify(text) that lowercases, replaces spaces with '-', strips non-alnum except '-', collapses repeats.

tasks.title: Implement Stack class
tasks.description: Implement only the source file under src/. Do NOT create or modify tests; golden tests are already provided. Create src/stack.py with Stack having push, pop, peek, is_empty, size. pop/peek on empty raise IndexError.
tasks.acceptance_criteria: stack ops work; empty pop/peek IndexError; unittest passes

tasks.title: Parse key=value lines
tasks.description: Implement only the source file under src/. Do NOT create or modify tests; golden tests are already provided. Create src/kv.py with parse_kv(text) returning dict from lines 'key=value', ignore blank/# comments, last duplicate wins.

tasks.title: Implement is_palindrome
tasks.description: Implement only the source file under src/. Do NOT create or modify tests; golden tests are already provided. Create src/palindrome.py with is_palindrome(text) ignoring case and non-alphanumeric chars.
tasks.acceptance_criteria: is_palindrome('A man, a plan, a canal: Panama') is True; empty True; unittest passes

tasks.title: Chunk a list
tasks.description: Implement only the source file under src/. Do NOT create or modify tests; golden tests are already provided. Create src/chunk.py with chunk_list(items, size) yielding/returning consecutive chunks. size < 1 raises ValueError.

tasks.title: Flatten one level
tasks.description: Implement only the source file under src/. Do NOT create or modify tests; golden tests are already provided. Create src/flatten.py with flatten_once(seq) flattening one nesting level only.
tasks.acceptance_criteria: flatten_once([1,[2,3],[4]])==[1,2,3,4]; nested deeper stays nested one level

tasks.title: Top-N counter
tasks.description: Implement only the source file under src/. Do NOT create or modify tests; golden tests are already provided. Create src/counter_top.py with top_n(items, n) returning most common items as list of (item, count) sorted by count desc then item. n<1 raises ValueError.

tasks.title: Safe division
tasks.description: Implement only the source file under src/. Do NOT create or modify tests; golden tests are already provided. Create src/safe_div.py with safe_div(a,b, default=None) returning a/b or default when b==0.

tasks.title: Money parse plus ledger
tasks.description: Implement only the source files under src/. Do NOT create or modify tests; golden tests are already provided. Create src/money.py with parse_cents(text)->int and format_cents(cents)->str, and src/ledger.py with Ledger.deposit/withdraw/transfer/balance. parse_cents accepts optional $, at most 2 decimal places, and a leading minus (1 -> 100, 1.2 -> 120, $1.20 -> 120, .5 -> 50, -0.05 -> -5). Reject empty, 3+ decimals, trailing dot, thousands separators. format_cents(120)=='1.20', format_cents(-5)=='-0.05'. Ledger amounts must be > 0, account names non-empty, transfer to the same account is an error, and insufficient funds raises ValueError without changing any balance. Unknown accounts have balance 0.
tasks.acceptance_criteria: money parsing and ledger transfers match the fixed tests; unittest passes

tasks.title: CSV read and write
tasks.description: Implement only the source files under src/. Do NOT create or modify tests; golden tests are already provided. Create src/csv_read.py with parse_csv(text)->list[dict] and src/csv_write.py with write_csv(rows, headers)->str. Header is the first record. Quote fields that contain comma, quote, or newline, and escape quotes by doubling. Empty input is []. Header-only is []. Duplicate headers and too many fields raise ValueError. A short row fills missing fields with ''. write_csv([], []) raises ValueError. write_csv([], ['name','note']) returns 'name,note\n'. Roundtrip quoted commas and quotes.
tasks.acceptance_criteria: CSV parse/write roundtrip and edge cases pass unittest

tasks.title: Template tags and filters
tasks.description: Implement only the source files under src/. Do NOT create or modify tests; golden tests are already provided. Create src/filters.py with apply_filter(value, name, arg='') supporting upper, lower, and default (empty value returns arg). Unknown filters raise ValueError. Create src/template.py with render(template, values) replacing {{ name }}, {{ name|filter }}, and {{ name|filter:arg }}. Whitespace inside braces is allowed. Missing names raise KeyError unless the filter is default. Unclosed '{{' raises ValueError. Text outside tags is unchanged.
tasks.acceptance_criteria: filters and template rendering match the fixed tests

tasks.title: Retry with backoff delays
tasks.description: Implement only the source files under src/. Do NOT create or modify tests; golden tests are already provided. Create src/backoff.py with backoff_ms(attempt, base_ms=100)->int where attempt is 1-based and the result is base_ms * 2**(attempt-1). attempt < 1 or base_ms < 0 raises ValueError. Create src/retry.py with retry(fn, retries, exceptions=(Exception,), sleep=None). retries is the number of extra attempts after the first call. retries < 0 raises ValueError. On a matching exception, call sleep(backoff_ms(n)) before each retry and re-raise the last error when retries are exhausted. Do not sleep after the final failure. Exceptions outside the tuple propagate immediately with no sleep.
tasks.acceptance_criteria: backoff sequence and retry/sleep behavior pass unittest

tasks.title: INI parse and dump
tasks.description: Implement only the source files under src/. Do NOT create or modify tests; golden tests are already provided. Create src/ini_parse.py with parse_ini(text)->dict[str, dict[str,str]] and src/ini_dump.py with dump_ini(sections)->str. Blank lines and full-line # or ; comments are ignored. Keys before any section go in section ''. Duplicate keys: last wins. A line that is not a section or key=value raises ValueError. dump_ini writes the '' section keys first with no header, then other sections sorted by name, keys sorted, and a trailing newline. dump_ini({})==''. Roundtrip simple values.
tasks.acceptance_criteria: INI comments, duplicates, and dump/parse roundtrip pass unittest

tasks.title: Bounded queue and drain
tasks.description: Implement only the source files under src/. Do NOT create or modify tests; golden tests are already provided. Create src/bqueue.py with BoundedQueue(maxsize) offering push, push_many, pop, peek, size, is_full, is_empty. maxsize < 1 raises ValueError. push on a full queue raises OverflowError. pop/peek on empty raises IndexError. push_many is atomic: if the items do not fit, raise OverflowError and leave the queue unchanged. FIFO. Create src/batch.py with drain(queue, limit) popping up to limit items, or fewer if the queue empties. limit < 1 raises ValueError. Draining an empty queue returns [].
tasks.acceptance_criteria: queue bounds, atomic push_many, and drain pass unittest

tasks.title: Merge intervals and coverage
tasks.description: Implement only the source files under src/. Do NOT create or modify tests; golden tests are already provided. Create src/intervals.py with merge_intervals(intervals)->list[list[int]]. Do not mutate the input. start > end raises ValueError. Sort and merge overlaps, including touching endpoints ([1,2] and [2,3] become [1,3]; [1,2] and [4,5] stay apart). Empty input returns []. Create src/coverage.py with covered_length(intervals)->int using the merged inclusive length (end-start+1) so [1,1] is 1 and overlaps are not double-counted.
tasks.acceptance_criteria: merged intervals and inclusive covered length pass unittest

tasks.title: JSON config and nested defaults
tasks.description: Implement only the source files under src/. Do NOT create or modify tests; golden tests are already provided. Create src/config_io.py with save_config(path, data) and load_config(path). data must be a dict or save_config raises TypeError before writing. Create parent directories. load_config raises FileNotFoundError when missing, and ValueError for invalid JSON. Create src/defaults.py with apply_defaults(data, defaults)->dict. Both arguments must be dicts or raise TypeError. Nested dicts merge and data wins. Lists are replaced, not concatenated. Do not mutate inputs, and do not share nested objects with the result.
tasks.acceptance_criteria: config roundtrip and nested defaults pass unittest

tasks.title: Graph and stable topological sort
tasks.description: Implement only the source files under src/. Do NOT create or modify tests; golden tests are already provided. Create src/graph.py with Graph.add_node, add_edge(source, target) meaning source before target, nodes()->sorted names, successors(name), predecessors(name). Empty names raise ValueError. add_edge creates missing nodes. Duplicate edges are ignored. successors/predecessors of an unknown node raise KeyError and return sorted names. Create src/topo.py with topo_sort(graph)->list[str]. Among ready nodes, always pick the lexicographically smallest. Include every node. A cycle, including a self-loop, raises ValueError. An empty graph returns [].
tasks.acceptance_criteria: stable topo order and cycle detection pass unittest

tasks.title: Query strings and URL parts
tasks.description: Implement only the source files under src/. Do NOT create or modify tests; golden tests are already provided. Create src/query.py with parse_query(text)->dict[str,str] and build_query(data)->str. Strip one leading ?. '+' is a space and percent-decoding applies. Duplicate keys: last wins. A key with no '=' has value ''. An empty key raises ValueError. build_query sorts keys, percent-encodes with %20 for spaces, and returns '' for {}. Create src/url_parts.py with split_url(url)->dict with keys scheme, host, path, query. Strip and ignore fragments. 'https://ex.com:8080/a/b?x=1#top' splits into those four fields. A path starting with / has empty scheme and host. A missing scheme that is not an absolute path raises ValueError. Userinfo ('@' in the host) raises ValueError.
tasks.acceptance_criteria: query codec and URL split match the fixed tests

tasks.title: Reverse word order
tasks.description: Implement only src/words.py. Do NOT create or modify tests. reverse_words(text) splits on any whitespace, reverses the word order, and joins with a single space. Leading and trailing whitespace is dropped. Empty text and whitespace-only text return ''.
tasks.acceptance_criteria: reverse_words('a  b')=='b a'; blank input is ''

tasks.title: Dedupe keeping the first item
tasks.description: Implement only src/unique.py. Do NOT create or modify tests. unique_keep(items) returns a new list with the first occurrence of each item kept and later duplicates removed. Do not mutate the input. An empty list returns [].
tasks.acceptance_criteria: unique_keep keeps first occurrence order and does not mutate

tasks.title: Title-case words
tasks.description: Implement only src/title_case.py. Do NOT create or modify tests. title_case(text) splits on whitespace. Each word's first character is uppercase and the rest is lowercase. Words are joined with a single space. Empty or whitespace-only text returns ''.

tasks.title: Balanced brackets
tasks.description: Implement only src/brackets.py. Do NOT create or modify tests. is_balanced(text) returns True when (), [], and {} are balanced and properly nested. Other characters are ignored. An empty string is True. A closer without a matching opener, or a mismatch, is False.
tasks.acceptance_criteria: is_balanced('([a])') is True; is_balanced('([)]') is False

tasks.title: Sum decimal digits
tasks.description: Implement only src/digits.py. Do NOT create or modify tests. digit_sum(value) sums the decimal digits of a non-negative int. 0 returns 0. A negative number, a bool, or a non-int raises ValueError.

tasks.title: Wrap words into lines
tasks.description: Implement only src/wrap.py. Do NOT create or modify tests. wrap_text(text, width) splits text on whitespace and packs words into lines of at most width characters, separated by one space. A word longer than width stays intact on its own line. width < 1 or a bool width raises ValueError. Empty or whitespace-only text returns []. Do not break a word.

tasks.title: Parse a comma-separated int list
tasks.description: Implement only src/int_list.py. Do NOT create or modify tests. parse_int_list(text) parses a comma-separated list of integers. Surrounding spaces around items are ignored. '' and whitespace-only text return []. An empty slot, a decimal, a plus sign, or a non-integer raises ValueError. A leading minus is allowed.

tasks.title: Rotate a list left
tasks.description: Implement only src/rotate.py. Do NOT create or modify tests. rotate_left(items, steps) returns a new list rotated left by steps positions. Negative steps rotate right. steps is taken modulo the length. An empty list returns [] for any int steps. Do not mutate the input. A bool or non-int steps raises ValueError.

tasks.title: Strip one prefix
tasks.description: Implement only src/prefix.py. Do NOT create or modify tests. strip_prefix(text, prefix) removes prefix once when text starts with it. Otherwise it returns text unchanged. An empty prefix returns text unchanged.

tasks.title: Compare anagrams
tasks.description: Implement only src/anagram.py. Do NOT create or modify tests. is_anagram(left, right) returns True when both strings contain the same letters and digits after ignoring case and non-alphanumeric characters. Two empty strings are anagrams. Order does not matter.

tasks.title: Running maximum
tasks.description: Implement only src/running.py. Do NOT create or modify tests. running_max(items) returns a new list where each position is the maximum value seen so far, including that position. An empty list returns []. Do not mutate the input. Negative numbers are valid.

tasks.title: Join URL path parts
tasks.description: Implement only src/url_path.py. Do NOT create or modify tests. join_url_path(*parts) strips spaces and slashes from each part, skips empty parts, and joins the rest with one slash. If the first argument, after stripping spaces, starts with '/', the result starts with '/'. No parts, or only empty parts, returns ''.

tasks.title: Mask an email local part
tasks.description: Implement only src/email_mask.py. Do NOT create or modify tests. mask_email(text) requires exactly one '@' and a non-empty local part and domain. Otherwise raise ValueError. Keep the first local character, replace every remaining local character with '*', and always emit at least one '*'. The domain is unchanged.

tasks.title: Count alphanumeric words
tasks.description: Implement only src/word_count.py. Do NOT create or modify tests. word_count(text) returns a dict of lowercase alphanumeric words ([A-Za-z0-9]+) to their counts. Punctuation and other characters are separators. Empty text returns {}.

tasks.title: Pad a string on the left
tasks.description: Implement only src/pad.py. Do NOT create or modify tests. pad_left(text, width, fill=' ') returns text when len(text) >= width. Otherwise it adds fill characters on the left until the length is width. width < 0 or a bool width raises ValueError. fill must be exactly one character, otherwise raise ValueError.

tasks.title: Drop None values
tasks.description: Implement only src/drop_none.py. Do NOT create or modify tests. drop_none(items) returns a new list without None values. Keep 0, False, and ''. Do not mutate the input.

tasks.title: Parse a boolean token
tasks.description: Implement only src/bools.py. Do NOT create or modify tests. parse_bool(text) strips text and compares it case-insensitively. true, yes, and 1 are True. false, no, and 0 are False. Anything else, including empty text, raises ValueError.
tasks.acceptance_criteria: parse_bool(' YES ') is True; parse_bool('maybe') raises ValueError

tasks.title: Zip lists of equal length
tasks.description: Implement only src/zip_strict.py. Do NOT create or modify tests. zip_strict(left, right) returns a list of pairs. Different lengths raise ValueError and do not partially zip. Two empty lists return []. Do not mutate either input.

tasks.title: Most frequent item
tasks.description: Implement only src/frequent.py. Do NOT create or modify tests. most_frequent(items) returns the item with the highest count. Ties go to the item whose first occurrence is earlier. An empty list raises ValueError. Do not mutate the input.

tasks.title: Collapse whitespace
tasks.description: Implement only src/spaces.py. Do NOT create or modify tests. collapse_spaces(text) replaces each run of whitespace with a single space and strips both ends. Empty or whitespace-only text returns ''.

tasks.title: Reduce fractions and add them
tasks.description: Implement only src/fraction.py and src/frac_math.py. Do NOT create or modify tests. reduce_fraction(numerator, denominator) returns a reduced (numerator, denominator). The denominator is always positive. The sign lives on the numerator. 0/n is (0, 1). A zero denominator, a bool, or a non-int raises ValueError. add_fractions(left, right) adds two (numerator, denominator) pairs and returns the reduced sum. Invalid parts raise ValueError.

tasks.title: Clean path segments and join them
tasks.description: Implement only src/path_clean.py and src/path_join.py. Do NOT create or modify tests. clean_segment(segment) strips spaces. An empty result, '.', '..', or a value containing '/' or '\\' raises ValueError. Otherwise it returns the stripped segment. join_path(segments) cleans every segment and joins them with '/'. An empty list raises ValueError.

tasks.title: Scan alphabetic words
tasks.description: Implement only src/token.py and src/scanner.py. Do NOT create or modify tests. is_word_token(text) is True only when text is non-empty and every character is a letter. scan_words(text) extracts maximal alphabetic runs, lowercases them, and returns them in order. Digits and punctuation are separators, not part of a word. Empty text returns [].

tasks.title: Ring buffer and last-n window
tasks.description: Implement only src/ring.py and src/window.py. Do NOT create or modify tests. Ring(capacity) stores items in arrival order. capacity < 1 or a bool raises ValueError. push drops the oldest item when size would exceed capacity. items() returns a new list from oldest to newest. size() returns the count. last_n(ring, n) returns the last n items from items(), or all of them if fewer exist. n < 1 or a bool n raises ValueError.
tasks.acceptance_criteria: Ring(2) keeps the two newest items; last_n reads the newest side

tasks.title: Parse a duration and add it to a clock
tasks.description: Implement only src/duration.py and src/clock.py. Do NOT create or modify tests. parse_duration(text) returns whole minutes. A bare non-negative integer is minutes. Otherwise the text is a concatenation of <digits>h and <digits>m pieces, lowercase only. Hours convert as 60 minutes. Empty text, a trailing number, an unknown unit, or a minus raises ValueError. add_minutes(hhmm, duration) parses a 24-hour HH:MM clock, adds parse_duration(duration), wraps inside one day, and returns HH:MM. Hour must be 00-23 and minute 00-59.

tasks.title: Parse and compare semantic versions
tasks.description: Implement only src/semver.py and src/version_cmp.py. Do NOT create or modify tests. parse_semver(text) requires exactly three dot-separated non-negative integers and returns (major, minor, patch). Each part must be digits. Anything else raises ValueError. compare_semver(left, right) returns -1, 0, or 1 using parse_semver.

tasks.title: Points and Manhattan distance
tasks.description: Implement only src/point.py and src/distance.py. Do NOT create or modify tests. Point(x, y) stores two ints. A bool or non-int coordinate raises TypeError. manhattan(left, right) returns abs(x2-x1)+abs(y2-y1). A non-Point argument raises TypeError.

tasks.title: Parse and format Roman numerals
tasks.description: Implement only src/roman_parse.py and src/roman_format.py. Do NOT create or modify tests. format_roman(value) converts an int from 1 to 3999 into a canonical uppercase Roman numeral. Use the standard subtractive pairs IV, IX, XL, XC, CD, and CM. Out of range, bool, or non-int raises ValueError. parse_roman(text) accepts only the canonical uppercase form and returns the int. Empty text, lowercase, or a non-canonical form such as IIII raises ValueError.

tasks.title: Transpose and multiply matrices
tasks.description: Implement only src/matrix.py and src/matmul.py. Do NOT create or modify tests. transpose(rows) returns a new matrix. An empty list returns []. A ragged matrix raises ValueError. Do not mutate the input. multiply(left, right) returns the matrix product. Empty or ragged matrices, or incompatible shapes, raise ValueError.

tasks.title: Escape text and render an attribute
tasks.description: Implement only src/html_escape.py and src/html_attr.py. Do NOT create or modify tests. escape_text(text) replaces & < > " and ' with & < > " and '. Replace & first so escapes are not double-encoded. render_attr(name, value) returns name="escaped value". name must match [A-Za-z][A-Za-z0-9_-]* or render_attr raises ValueError.

tasks.title: Parse counts and merge them
tasks.description: Implement only src/counts.py and src/count_merge.py. Do NOT create or modify tests. parse_counts(text) parses comma-separated key:count pairs into a dict. Empty or whitespace-only text returns {}. Duplicate keys in one string are summed. Keys are stripped. Counts are non-negative integers. A missing colon, an empty key, or a negative count raises ValueError. merge_counts(parts) parses each string and sums counts across parts.

tasks.title: Split emails and compare domains
tasks.description: Implement only src/email_split.py and src/email_domain.py. Do NOT create or modify tests. split_email(text) requires exactly one '@', a non-empty local part, and a domain that contains a dot and does not start or end with a dot. Both parts are stripped and lowercased. Otherwise raise ValueError. same_domain(left, right) compares the domains.

tasks.title: Parse an inclusive span and test a point
tasks.description: Implement only src/span.py and src/span_query.py. Do NOT create or modify tests. parse_span(text) parses 'start-end' or a single integer into an inclusive pair. Both ends are non-negative integers. start > end raises ValueError. A non-integer raises ValueError. span_contains(span, point) uses that pair. A bool or non-int point raises ValueError.

tasks.title: Split lines and count non-empty ones
tasks.description: Implement only src/lines.py and src/line_stats.py. Do NOT create or modify tests. split_lines(text) returns lines separated by '\n'. A single trailing newline does not create an extra empty line. Empty text returns []. Internal empty lines are kept. count_nonempty(text) counts lines whose stripped text is non-empty.

tasks.title: Parse ratios and multiply them
tasks.description: Implement only src/ratio.py and src/ratio_math.py. Do NOT create or modify tests. parse_ratio(text) parses 'n/d' or a bare integer (denominator 1) into a reduced pair. The denominator is always positive and the sign is on the numerator. 0/n is (0, 1). A zero denominator or a non-integer raises ValueError. multiply_ratios(left, right) multiplies two ratio strings and returns the reduced pair.

tasks.title: Parse a temperature and convert it
tasks.description: Implement only src/temp_parse.py and src/temp_convert.py. Do NOT create or modify tests. parse_temp(text) strips spaces and reads a number plus a final C or F, case-insensitive. It returns (value, 'C' or 'F'). A missing unit or a bad number raises ValueError. convert_temp(text, unit) converts to the target unit. C = (F-32)*5/9 and F = C*9/5+32. The result is one decimal digit plus the upper-case unit, such as '0.0C'. An unknown target unit raises ValueError.

tasks.title: Parse points and measure a bounding box
tasks.description: Implement only src/bbox.py and src/bbox_area.py. Do NOT create or modify tests. parse_point(text) parses 'x,y' into a pair of ints. Spaces around the numbers are allowed. A non-integer raises ValueError. area(corners) parses at least one point and returns (max_x-min_x)*(max_y-min_y). An empty list raises ValueError. A single point has area 0.

tasks.title: Parse log levels and filter lines
tasks.description: Implement only src/level.py and src/level_filter.py. Do NOT create or modify tests. parse_level(name) strips and lowercases debug=10, info=20, warn=30, error=40. An unknown name raises ValueError. filter_lines(lines, minimum) keeps lines whose level is greater than or equal to minimum. Each line is 'LEVEL message' with a non-empty message. A bad line raises ValueError. Do not mutate the input list. Return the original line strings.

tasks.title: Normalize keys and store them
tasks.description: Implement only src/prefix_norm.py and src/prefix_table.py. Do NOT create or modify tests. normalize_key(text) strips, lowercases, and collapses internal whitespace to one space. An empty result raises ValueError. PrefixTable.add(key, value) stores the normalized key. A later add replaces the value. get(key) returns it or raises KeyError when missing.
tasks.acceptance_criteria: normalize_key('  A   B ')=='a b'; later add wins

tasks.title: Normalize SKUs and track inventory
tasks.description: Implement only src/sku.py and src/inventory.py. Do NOT create or modify tests. normalize_sku(text) strips and uppercases. The result must match [A-Z0-9]+(?:-[A-Z0-9]+)* or it raises ValueError. Inventory.add(sku, qty) adds a positive int quantity. remove(sku, qty) subtracts a positive int and raises ValueError, without changing the count, when the stock is insufficient. count(sku) returns 0 for an unknown SKU. A bool or non-positive quantity raises ValueError.
tasks.acceptance_criteria: normalize_sku(' ab-12 ')=='AB-12'; remove does not mutate on failure
